about: Reviewed licence exceptions for the console's production tree (read by scripts/check-licences.mjs). The allowed list is unchanged; each entry is pinned to name@version AND the exact licence declared when reviewed, so a new version or a changed licence fails the build again. All four arrive through @gorules/jdm-editor 1.52.0 -> exceljs 4.4.0. Decided by arjun-fullstack at the E6 wave-1 integration (2026-10-11); buffers is flagged to Dipesh for sign-off.

exceptions.reason: Both licences are permissive and OSI-approved (Zlib asks only that the origin is not misrepresented and the notice is kept in source). Shipped in the console bundle through exceljs -> jszip.
MIT/X11 is the MIT licence under its older name, not an SPDX id. Build-time only: exceljs Node path (unzipper -> binary); not present in the shipped console bundle (checked by searching dist/assets).

MIT/X11 is the MIT licence under its older name, not an SPDX id. Build-time only: exceljs Node path (unzipper -> binary -> chainsaw); not present in the shipped console bundle (checked by searching dist/assets).

Declares no licence (package.json, README and the npm registry carry none; the upstream repository is gone). Build-time only: exceljs Node path (unzipper -> binary); not present in the shipped console bundle (checked by searching dist/assets), so nothing of it is distributed. Pending Dipesh's sign-off; to remove it, delete this entry and the build fails again on it.
